Application Data.NAME: Healthy Med Supplies Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Healthy Med Supplies Inc. is a reputable corporation specializing in the distribution of medical and hospital supplies, including a wide range of products from personal protective equipment to diagnostic tools. Our operations focus on providing high-quality, compliant medical supplies to healthcare providers, ensuring they have access to the necessary tools for patient care. We prioritize customer satisfaction through reliable service and timely delivery, while adhering to strict health and safety regulations. Our facility is equipped with advanced inventory management systems, and we maintain a commitment to quality by sourcing products from certified manufacturers. We do not engage in equipment rental services, which helps minimize associated risks. Our team is trained in loss control measures, ensuring a safe environment for our customers and staff.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2022, a slip-and-fall incident occurred at our retail location resulting in minor injuries to a customer. The cause was an unintentional spill of a cleaning solution in an aisle. The claim was settled for $5,000, and the status was closed with no further action required.

Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Rating A, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrols and surveillance cameras installed throughout the facility, with regular inspections and maintenance of safety equipment.
